data.revised_prompt:
Create a clean HD pixel-inspired 2D game FX-only animation sprite sheet, exactly 1536x1024 PNG, 3 rows x 4 columns, 12 equal frames, no visible grid lines or labels. Entire background is solid flat #FF00FF magenta across the whole sheet including all spacing between frames. Each frame contains only the same attack FX identity, centered in its cell, same approximate scale, with clear magenta padding so nothing touches or crosses the cell edges.

Use the first reference image only as palette and theme reference: electric cyan dragonfire, deep blue shadow flame, ivory white hot core, gold royal armor/sigil language, polished aquatic dragon-prince energy. Use the second reference image only as a layout guide for the 3x4 frame placement and safe padding. Do not draw Jay, any character body, dragon head, face, eyes, claws, hands, armor, cloak, shoulder plates, weapon, creature silhouette, or full dragon. FX-only asset.

Concept: “Royal Dragon Verdict - Macro Elite FX” — a grand ceremonial after-attack battlefield-wide judgment effect. The composition is threatening, elite, and macro-scale: layered gold law seals, huge cyan-white dragonfire tide, abstract card-light shards being pulled into a decree circle, horn-like crescent arcs, scale-like flame edges, royal gold geometry, aquatic blue energy, and a vertical judgment flare. No painterly scene, no realistic smoke, no background elements, no UI.

Frame sequence, left to right then top to bottom:
1) Large faint gold decree circle opens, covering about half the frame, cyan spark in the center.
2) Circle deepens into a blue-white vortex well, gold card-light shards orbit around the full ring.
3) Macro charge: several sweeping cyan flame crescents pull inward from the edges, forming a large royal seal.
4) Full sigil lock: layered gold law rings, ivory core, blue flame crown, large and ceremonial.
5) Judgement descends: a broad vertical blue-white energy pillar pierces the center of the seal.
6) Pillar erupts into a cross-shaped dragonfire shock, with horn-like cyan crescents sweeping across the frame.
7) Peak elite impact: largest frame, white-hot core, layered gold royal circles, wide cyan flame tide and card-shard halo filling most safe area.
8) Macro shockwave expands: huge cyan circular wave, gold ring fractures, blue flame curls backward.
9) Verdict fracture: the law seal breaks into many large card-light shards, still forming a broad circular composition.
10) Receding tide: sweeping blue dragonfire wave spirals away across most of the frame, gold fragments trailing.
11) Aftermath field: large fading royal sigil outline, scattered cyan embers and gold shard constellation.
12) Loop-ready residual: faint but still broad decree circle and central cyan star, not a tiny dot, ready to fade or loop.

Style: polished clean HD sprite with pixel-inspired crisp edges, high contrast aquatic blue/cyan/white/gold palette, sharp readable silhouette, smooth glow, exact same FX identity in every frame, no text, no numbers, no watermarks, no borders. Ensure frames 3-10 are especially large and grand, occupying most of the safe area. Keep everything fully inside each frame.
